_doc: Store-site price adapters for GET /prices (#903). One entry per chain whose own site search answers with schema.org JSON-LD offers in its static HTML. Nothing is fetched unless the entry is enabled AND the site's robots.txt lets scrappers-api fetch the URL (scrapers/_robots.py). `brands` is what the caller's OSM brand/name tags are matched against (lowercase). A chain that blocks automated clients, forbids the path in robots.txt, or serves prices only through JavaScript is listed disabled with the reason, never guessed.

obi.label: OBI
obi.terms: robots.txt allows the search path (checked per request); prices are the chain's ONLINE shop price from the page's JSON-LD ItemList, not a branch shelf price. The owner has not reviewed the site's terms of use.

euronics.label: Euronics
euronics.terms: robots.txt allows the search path (checked per request); prices are the chain's ONLINE shop price from the page's JSON-LD ItemList, not a branch shelf price. The owner has not reviewed the site's terms of use.

saturn.label: Saturn
saturn.why: Same shop platform as MediaMarkt; answers 403 to automated clients.

ikea.label: IKEA
ikea.why: Search page carries no JSON-LD offers (prices are in a JS bundle); not read.

hornbach.label: Hornbach
hornbach.why: Search page is rendered by JavaScript; no static offers to read.
